references.text: Here are given the detailed regulations for grain offerings and drink offerings that were to accompany bulls, rams, and lambs—the same 'according to the regulation' referred to in Numbers 29:30.
Describes the fixed amounts for grain offerings and drink offerings for the daily sacrifices, which form the basis for 'according to the regulation' in the festival offerings.
The same wording is used for grain offerings and drink offerings on the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles, showing the recurring pattern throughout the entire feast.
Parallel text from the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles with identical wording regarding grain offerings and drink offerings 'according to the regulation'.
The same wording is repeated for the seventh day of the Feast of Tabernacles, confirming the consistent sacrifice pattern.
Summarizes the Lord's feasts with burnt offerings, grain offerings, peace offerings, and drink offerings—each on its appointed day.
